title: Coherent advantage in the computational expressivity of excitonic networks
summary: The rising energy consumption of AI has generated interest in physical systems as alternative substrates for trainable computation. Recent experimental advances have enabled precise control over the couplings between molecular chromophores, which give rise to coherent excitation dynamics. Here, we study driven-dissipative excitonic networks as a computational platform, where the intersite couplings define the input and the steady state defines the output.
